title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: The Tourney Continues (Class # 34)

chapters.title: Introduction and Malka's Letter
chapters.about: Reading a letter from Malka about facing intense challenges and fear.

chapters.title: Rabbi Sachs on Yaakov and the Angel
chapters.about: Extracting blessings from darkness and struggle following Rabbi Jonathan Sachs.

chapters.title: Community Love and Hidden Kindness
chapters.about: How community support and love emerge like a geyser during difficult times.

chapters.title: Medical Updates and Treatment
chapters.about: Updates on the baby's biopsy, low grade glioma, and starting chemotherapy.

summary: Mrs. Tawil shares a personal letter from her daughter Malka detailing the family's journey through a baby's serious illness, focusing on finding faith and extracting blessings from hardship. She discusses lessons on perspective, community support, and appreciating life's basic necessities rather than getting caught up in frustrations or frills.
questions: How can we find blessing and growth in times of severe personal hardship?
What does the struggle of Yaakov with the angel teach us about facing darkness?
How does a community's hidden love and kindness emerge during difficult times?
What are the true bare necessities of life according to Yaakov's prayer?
